mathematical_moves: Construct a symbolic polynomial remainder over Q[a] using the relation x^2 = x - a.
Compute the common polynomial gcd of the remainder coefficients and derive the unique integral root.
Verify the exact quotient by multiplication at the derived parameter.

current_capabilities.boundary: Computes a polynomial gcd and Bezout witness for supplied polynomials; symbolic remainder construction and the divisibility-family interpretation remain agent-owned.

analysis.next_action: Use this as a regression case for composing symbolic remainder construction, polynomial gcd, and exact quotient verification without hard-coding the public parameter.
